description: Mnemosyne persistent memory hooks for Cursor — context injection at session start, episodic collapse at session end. TEMPLATE: `mnemo install` replaces ${MNEMO_PLUGIN_ROOT} with an absolute path before writing ~/.cursor/hooks.json, because Cursor does not document variable expansion in hook commands and betting on it would fail silently. Event names are camelCase here and PascalCase in hooks.json; they are NOT interchangeable — a copied manifest subscribes to nothing. beforeSubmitPrompt is deliberately absent: Cursor documents `additional_context` on sessionStart and postToolUse only, so a per-prompt nudge would run and inject nothing.
